corrections.text: The title says "Analysts Point to a Shared DuckDB Dependency". The statement that pgEdge's ColdFront, Snowflake's pg_lake and Databricks' Lakebase all rely on DuckDB comes from one analyst, Igor Ikonnikov of Info-Tech Research Group, in a single InfoWorld article dated June 26, 2026, which also presents the convergence in its own reporting voice. The article body attributes the point to Ikonnikov correctly; the plural in the title overstates the number of analysts making it.
